current.text: He re-signed with Washington on a cheap three-year deal. Part of the reason is the mentoring he gives young players.
He is not in the projected starting five. The projected starters are Trae Young, Kyshawn George, AJ Dybantsa, Anthony Davis and Alex Sarr.
Washington has a crowded group of wings and guards. The fifth starter spot is open, with many wings competing for it.
It is unclear how much he will play. One expert expects a 10 or 11 man rotation, with 12 or 13 players who could justify minutes.
Washington is trying to compete this season. The late-season rest and minutes cuts of past years should not come back.

durable.text: His projected line has no strong category. His best categories are FT% and turnovers, and both come on low volume.

tags.name: minutes competition
tags.detail: Many Washington wings compete for minutes and the fifth starter spot. He is not in the projected starting five.

note: Yahoo ranks him 247th and ESPN ranks him 286th. Both sites value him at 0 USD, and he went for 1 USD in our auction last season. That puts him well outside the 144 players we draft, so do not draft him. Last season he scored 10.2 points on 42.0% shooting in 22.8 minutes, and his role on a deep Washington wing rotation is unclear. Leave him on waivers and pick him up only if early-season box scores show him getting starter minutes.
